stories.title: Night Night, Little Farm
stories.summary: A soft, repeating goodnight to the cow, the hen, the pig, and the moon over a sleepy farm.

stories.title: The Littlest Pumpkin's Lantern
stories.summary: A small pumpkin on a quiet porch learns her soft glow is just right for helping a sleepy moth find home.

stories.title: Otto and the Cloud Ferry
stories.summary: A curious otter rides a fluffy cloud ferry across the night sky to deliver a lost star back home.
